SAME.description: The marked mention refers to the candidate entry: the same thing, at the level the entry describes. Read the passage, the entry's name, other names and description.
do_not_mark: an entry with the same name for a different thing, e.g. another species, product or place of the same name
a broader or narrower entry than the mention, unless the guidelines say to link to that level
a mention that only names a group or category the entry belongs to
